occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation: A background check has not been submitted for two adult household members.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation (26 TAC §745.621(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: The carbon monoxide detection system is not being tested monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills are not being conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience: The primary caregiver did not receive six clock hours of training in management techniques, leadership and supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(2))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year: Severe weather drills are not being conducted 4 times  a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering drill for Severe Weather- 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(2))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Smoke detectors are not being tested monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguisher is not being checked monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not receive training in emergency preparedness, communicable diseases including immunizations, food allergies, administering medications, understanding building and physical premises safety and handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: A completed admission form was not on file for the two children enrolled in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: The childcare home did not have the reqiuired admissions information on file. A copy of the Vietnamese admission form was emailed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR also Includes Expiration Date  or Renewal: Documentation of First Aid and CPR training was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR also Includes Expiration Date  or Renewal (26 TAC §747.1327(c)(1)(B))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The date, start time, exit time of the fire drills and severe weather drills are not being documented. The checks of the smoke detector, carbon monoxide detector and fire extinguisher are not being documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan: The emergency preparedness plan was not available for review.
